title: TI4 Seat Colours
description: Seat/player colours replaced by the TI4 traditional set, ordered blue, green, white, red, pink, orange, yellow, purple so small games get distinct hues and the two reds never sit together. Before shots use the old Okabe-Ito set on the commit without the change; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- DF. Mocked fixtures.

notes.title: Order
notes.text: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 white, 4 red, 5 pink, 6 orange, 7 yellow, 8 purple (symbols unchanged). Seat ink is dark on every colour (contrast 4.5:1 or better), chosen per fill instead of the old seat-8 special case.

notes.title: Colour-blind limits
notes.text: At 8 players blue and purple collapse under deuteranopia (min delta E 0.9); at 6 or more red and orange are close for deutan viewers. The seat symbols stay the second channel.
